key.name: rules
key.description: One rule per entry: (application, match, text, workspace). The application is a desktop file id such as 'google-chrome.desktop'; for windows the shell matches to no application, their window class. The match is 'any' (every window of the application), 'is' (the window title is the text), 'contains' (the title contains the text) or 'matches' (the title matches the text as a JavaScript regular expression); case does not matter. The workspace counts from 1. A window opening is moved by the most specific rule that matches it: 'is' before 'matches' before 'contains' before 'any', and in list order among equals. Rules with an unknown match, an empty text, an invalid regular expression or a workspace outside 1-36 are ignored.

key.name: home-request
key.description: Written by the settings window, any new value asks the extension to apply the rules to the windows already open.
